svg.text: MIN. 10.4 m (SEALS AT FULL VACUUM) · NOTE 3
CONTROL VALVE, DIAPHRAGM · FC/FO = FAIL CLOSED/OPEN
REMOTE HAND VALVE HV (DCS HIC) · FAIL POS. HOLD
SURFACE CONDENSER (SHELL & TUBE, CW IN TUBES)
UTILITY LINE (MS, CW, N2, STEAM CONDENSATE)
VG VACUUM GAS · MS MP STEAM · SC STEAM CONDENSATE
CW COOLING WATER · NG NITROGEN · CD CONDENSATE
PV PROCESS VAPOUR · PL PROCESS LIQUID · LS LP STEAM
1. EJECTOR SIZING (LECTURE 7, 2105416 METHOD): 2 STAGES, EQUAL RATIO r = (110 / 7)^(1/2) = 3.96 → INTERCONDENSER 7.0 × 3.96 = 27.75 kPa a AT 50 °C.
2. LOAD 18.54 kg/h AIR-EQUIVALENT (HEI AIR LEAK, VD-PID-101 NOTE 3). ENTRAINMENT RATIO 0.35 (J-201) / 0.21 (J-202) FROM THE DeFRATE–HOERL
CHARTS, MW/T CORRECTION, +20 % STEAM MARGIN → MOTIVE STEAM 41.6 / 105 kg/h AT 10 BAR A.
3. E-201 → V-201 BAROMETRIC LEG: MIN. 10.4 m VERTICAL, NO POCKETS = 101.3 kPa / (ρ 990 × 9.81) → SEALS EVEN AT FULL VACUUM (AT DESIGN 27.75 kPa a: 7.6 m).
REV A SAID MIN. 9 m (7.5 m + MARGIN): THAT LEG LOSES ITS SEAL BELOW ≈ 14 kPa a IN E-201. E-202 (110 kPa a) DRAINS BY SEAL LEG.
4. E-202 VENT PASSES FA-201 AND SL-201 TO ATMOSPHERE AT A SAFE LOCATION; J-203 DISCHARGES THROUGH SL-203 TO ATMOSPHERE.
5. PV-201 N2 BLEED (FC) IS THE FINAL ELEMENT OF PIC-101 ON VD-PID-101: MORE N2 → HIGHER COLUMN PRESSURE. EJECTORS RUN AT CONSTANT MOTIVE STEAM.
6. CONDENSATE CONTAINS ACETIC ACID: CONDENSER SHELLS, LEGS, V-201, P-201A/B IN SS316; SEND TO WASTE-WATER TREATMENT.
7. INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT & TEST VALVES (TYP.). UNTAGGED MANUAL VALVES = ISOLATION (NOT SIMULATED). NRVs ON N2 INJECTIONS PREVENT BACK-FLOW.
8. TBC: LINE SIZES, CONDENSER AREAS, PUMP RATINGS, SL/FA SIZING, HOTWELL VOLUME. ALARM SETTINGS: C&E VD-IN-CE-001.
9. REV B: FI-213, HIC-201 / 202 / 205 ADDED (DCS TAGS OF THE SIMULATOR); HV-201 / HV-205 SHOWN ON THE CW RETURN, REMOTE-OPERATED. HV FAIL POSITIONS: HOLD.
10. HOLD — RECOMMENDED, NOT INSTALLED (NOT DRAWN): O2 ANALYSER ON THE VENT GAS (R04), ΔP ACROSS FA-201 (R05), XV-203 POSITION SWITCH + SECOND
ISOLATION (R06), HOTWELL LOW ALARM (R07), HOTWELL OVERFLOW TO CLOSED DRAIN (R08), N2 HEADER LOW-PRESSURE ALARM (R26), PSV ON STEAM CHESTS (TBC).
11. NUMBERS FROM THE SIMULATOR MODEL (STEAM EJECTOR VACUUM OTS VER 1) AND THE LECTURE DESIGN BASIS. ISSUED FOR TEACHING.
START-UP: (1) CW TO E-201/E-202 AND CHILLED WATER TO E-103 ON (2) PIC-210 IN AUTO (10.0 BAR A)
(3) OPEN XV-212: J-202 STEAM (LAST STAGE FIRST) (4) OPEN XV-211: J-201 STEAM (5) OPEN XV-201.
HOGGING: OPEN XV-213 (STEAM) FIRST, THEN XV-203. BELOW 20 kPa a: CLOSE XV-203 FIRST, THEN XV-213.
I-2 LSLL-201 (HOTWELL LOW-LOW, < 10 %) STOPS P-201A/B — KEEPS THE BAROMETRIC SEAL. RESTART ONLY ABOVE 12 %.
I-3 PERMISSIVE: XV-203 CANNOT OPEN UNLESS XV-213 IS OPEN (PREVENTS AIR BACK-FLOW INTO THE COLUMN).
A. MOTIVE STEAM MUST BE DRY (S-210 / ST-210) AND ≥ 10 BAR A AT THE NOZZLES; BELOW ≈ 9.5 BAR A J-202 "BREAKS" FIRST (PIC-210 LOW ALARM 9.7).
B. BAROMETRIC LEGS SEALED AT ALL TIMES; NEVER PUMP V-201 BELOW LSLL-201.
C. BREAK VACUUM WITH N2 ONLY (HV-202) — NEVER WITH AIR. PV-210 FAILS OPEN: MOTIVE STEAM KEPT ON AIR FAILURE.
D. PI-211 / 212 / 213 = STEAM-CHEST PRESSURE AT EACH EJECTOR NOZZLE; FI-210 = J-201 + J-202 MOTIVE STEAM, FI-213 = HOGGER STEAM.
